section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study conducted in Jakarta, Indonesia, comprising 262 women and 278 men (total N=540) with a mean age of 43.19 years and mean BMI of 22.08 kg/m². The sample included participants of diverse ancestry (48.1% Javanese, 43.7% Sundanese, 8.1% Chinese). No information is provided about survey method, educational attainment, body appreciation assessment instrument, or BMI assessment method.
